# Adaptation Differences Across UE Versions

This page is organized by soloAS version.

- [0.2.x (current, supports UE 5.7, 5.8)](#02x-current-version-supports-ue-57-58)
- [0.1.x (supports UE 5.4–5.8)](#01x-supports-ue-5458)

## 0.2.x (current version · supports UE 5.7, 5.8)

### Core plugins

| Difference | Affected versions | Scope | Description | User impact |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Externalized container override state | 5.7 | Editor only | UE 5.7 lacks externalized override state. The engine warns, ignores Externalized operations and imports the value as an ordinary override. **The UE-AS fork behaves the same in these versions.** | Use a newer editor supporting externalization when the externalized semantics must be preserved. |

### GAS

Behavior is consistent across supported versions; no known differences at this time.

### Enhanced Input

Behavior is consistent across supported versions; no known differences at this time.

## 0.1.x (supports UE 5.4–5.8)

### Core plugins (0.1.x)

| Difference | Affected versions | Scope | Description | User impact |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Replication timing for mixed properties | 5.4, 5.5, 5.6 | Runtime | UE 5.4 through 5.6 continue checking the full property set for objects mixing ordinary and marked replication. UE 5.7 and later can check marked properties individually. **The UE-AS fork behaves the same in these versions.** | In UE 5.4 through 5.6, a property may still be sent without being marked as changed. For strict control that prevents such sends, use generic replication or upgrade to UE 5.7 or later. |
| Externalized container override state | 5.4, 5.5, 5.6, 5.7 | Editor only | UE 5.4–5.7 lack externalized override state. On 5.4/5.5 soloAS explicitly rejects Externalized operations before import; on 5.6/5.7 the engine warns, ignores the operation and imports the value as an ordinary override. **The UE-AS fork behaves the same in these versions.** | Use a newer editor supporting externalization when the externalized semantics must be preserved. |
| Null object keys in incremental map overrides (editor only) | 5.5.4 | Editor only | UE 5.5.4 cannot represent null object map keys in incremental overrides; UE 5.6–5.8 also assert, so this limitation is not specific to older versions. **The UE-AS fork behaves the same in these versions.** | The importer explicitly rejects the key before the native assertion; non-null keys are unaffected. |
| Script directory NonUFS staging configuration | 5.4, 5.5, 5.6, 5.7, 5.8 | Editor only | Packaging uses the ../Script staging default from the plugin Game.ini. Projects can append directories but cannot remove this default with - or !. **The UE-AS fork places this entry in engine BaseGame so projects can remove it; soloAS retains the plugin layer to preserve staging defaults in external packaging tools.** | Only removal of the script directory staging entry is affected; normal script packaging and game execution are unchanged. |

### GAS (0.1.x)

| Difference | Affected versions | Scope | Description | User impact |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Loose gameplay tag replication setting | 5.4, 5.5, 5.6 | Runtime | UE 5.4–5.6 do not provide a replication-count setting. soloAS exposes the same parameter as UE 5.8 on these versions, with None available and TagOnly aligned for server-authority calls. CountToOwner, TagAndCountToAll and SimulatedTagOnly raise explicit script errors. Count replication requires UE 5.7 or newer; SimulatedTagOnly requires UE 5.8 or newer. **The UE-AS fork behaves the same in these versions.** | None and TagOnly are available on legacy versions; count replication requires an engine upgrade. Parent tag counts during client prediction may differ from UE 5.8. |

### Enhanced Input (0.1.x)

Behavior is consistent across supported versions; no known differences at this time.
